description: Three terminal coding agents herdr runs, through their vendors' curl installers: Maki, Devin CLI and Oh My Pi.
why: Each agent has one witness here: ~/.local/bin/maki, ~/.local/bin/devin, and ~/.omp, which omp writes when run. ~/.local/bin/omp is on disk and claims nothing, so the Oh My Pi finding is ~/.omp's alone, and removing any of the three values turns must_find red. Oh My Pi is a fork of Pi, so pi and openclaw (built on Pi's libraries) are forbidden; windsurf because its cask is devin-desktop; claude-code and codex-cli because ~/.local/bin and top-level home directories are their routes too.
known_gaps: Maki's, Devin CLI's and Oh My Pi's Windows installers are not exercised.
